ENG_london_recount = {
set_variable = { global.ENG_london_members = 0 } set_global_flag = { flag = MTG_naval_treaty_signatories value = 0 } every_country = { if = { limit = { has_naval_treaty_trigger = yes } set_country_flag = ENG_london_was_member add_to_variable = { global.ENG_london_members = 1 } modify_global_flag = { flag = MTG_naval_treaty_signatories value = 1 } } else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ENG_london_was_member } clr_country_flag = ENG_london_was_member set_global_flag = ENG_london_withdrawal } }
}

ENG_london_dissolve = {
set_global_flag = ENG_london_ended clr_global_flag = ENG_london_conference_busy every_country = { limit = { has_naval_treaty_trigger = yes } remove_ideas = MTG_naval_treaty_adherent remove_ideas = MTG_naval_treaty_cheating remove_ideas = MTG_naval_treaty_adherent_reduced remove_ideas = MTG_naval_treaty_cheating_reduced set_country_flag = MTG_naval_treaty_abandoned } ENG_london_recount = yes
}

ENG_london_tick = {
if = { limit = { has_global_flag = ENG_london_ended } every_country = { limit = { has_naval_treaty_trigger = yes } remove_ideas = MTG_naval_treaty_adherent remove_ideas = MTG_naval_treaty_cheating remove_ideas = MTG_naval_treaty_adherent_reduced remove_ideas = MTG_naval_treaty_cheating_reduced set_country_flag = MTG_naval_treaty_abandoned } } ENG_london_recount = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = ENG_london_ended } OR = { check_variable = { var = global.ENG_london_members value = 3 compare = less_than } any_country = { has_naval_treaty_trigger = yes any_enemy_country = { has_naval_treaty_trigger = yes } } } } ENG_london_dissolve = yes }
}

ENG_london_withdraw = {
remove_naval_treaty_effect = yes set_global_flag = ENG_london_withdrawal ENG_london_tick = yes every_other_country = { limit = { has_naval_treaty_trigger = yes } country_event = { id = nww_london.1 days = 1 } }
}

ENG_london_escalate = {
set_global_flag = ENG_london_escalated clr_global_flag = ENG_london_conference_busy every_country = { limit = { has_naval_treaty_trigger = yes } if = { limit = { has_idea = MTG_naval_treaty_adherent } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = MTG_naval_treaty_adherent add_idea = MTG_naval_treaty_adherent_reduced } } else_if = { limit = { has_idea = MTG_naval_treaty_cheating } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = MTG_naval_treaty_cheating add_idea = MTG_naval_treaty_cheating_reduced } } country_event = { id = nww_london.2 days = 1 } }
}
